content: This mattress is an absolute disaster and a complete waste of money. From the moment I unboxed it, I could tell this was going to be an issue. The "medium firmness" advertised feels more like sleeping on a lumpy, deflated pool float. Any attempt to get comfortable results in sinking uncomfortably deep, forcing my spine into an unnatural and painful position. It also sleeps incredibly hot; I wake up feeling like I've been in a sauna every single night. My back pain has significantly worsened since I started using this, which is the exact opposite of what I was hoping for. Honestly, sleeping on the floor would be preferable to this abysmal excuse for a mattress. Save yourself the agony and a whole lot of money by looking elsewhere.
